levels.surface: أبي مرة، مولى عقيل بن أبي طالب

notes: One saying with one chain; the Companion Umm Hani is the last link, the Prophet is not written
Tirmidhi's remarks after the matn («وقد روي عن عمر ...», «وقد روي عن علي ... وعبد الله بن عمرو») are commentary with no isnad for this saying: left out
«أبو عيسى» is the compiler (added by the tool), not written
